text:
Type: molded shell dining chair
Use: dining, working at a desk; dining room, kitchen, home office
Style: modern, retro, contemporary
Materials: molded plastic shell, chrome-plated steel tube legs
Colors: light sky blue, silver chrome
Shape: one-piece curved scoop shell with a tall rounded back, armless, four thin straight metal legs, light and open, compact
Feel: fresh, cheerful, light, playful
Goes with: white tables, light wood, chrome accents; bright modern kitchens, retro or pastel dining rooms
